items.title: Malaysia’s Pork Imports Surge More Than Fivefold In Five Years
items.summary: Malaysia’s pork imports surged 5.5-fold between 2020 and 2025, meeting about 37% of domestic requirements. KPKM approved 181 importer registrations from 11 countries, while live pig exports remain limited to Singapore.
